prompt: Photorealistic studio product rendering, isometric view from slightly below and to the side, on a plain seamless light-grey studio backdrop with soft product lighting. Show a close-up cropped midspan segment of a steel footbridge deck, cut off cleanly at the backdrop, not the full span: horizontal deck slab on top with two longitudinal girders beneath. Clamped across the girders with preloaded high-strength bolts are two transverse steel bearer beams. Suspended centrally below the frame on vertical helical steel springs and vertical viscous dashpot cylinders is a large rectangular tuned steel mass block about waist-high relative to girder depth, free to move vertically with a visible stroke gap above a removable under-deck cover panel shown lowered and offset to reveal the moving parts. Fixed parts are deck, girders, bearer frame and bolt clamps; moving part is the steel mass on springs with dashpots stroking vertically. Show real materials: painted deck steel, dark structural frame, solid machined mass, bright coiled springs with threaded seats and shims, cylindrical oil dampers. Show load path pedestrians to deck to frame to springs and dampers to moving mass. Add a short callout with thin leader line for each focus part on a small light tag placed in empty space: Bridge Deck Section, Transverse Bearer Frame, Tuned Steel Mass, Helical Support Springs, Viscous Dashpots, Removable Cover Panel. Clean legible callouts, no other text, no margins, no scale bars.
must_not: rooms, landscapes, sky, vegetation or buildings
furniture, tools, scaffolding or lifting towers
diagram arrows, circles, colour blocks or line sketches
overlaid numbers, values or engineering notes
dimension lines, scale bars, margins or title blocks
welded joints or altered deck top surface
changes_from_previous: First rendering from mechanism sketches, no previous image to revise.

visual_plan.view: isometric from below-side, slightly under deck level looking up at midspan unit
visual_plan.spatial_layout: Top: cropped horizontal deck slab. Beneath: two parallel girders left-right. Across them: two transverse bearer beams front-back. Center: rectangular mass block. Between frame and mass: four outer coil springs and two inner dashpot cylinders vertical. Below: thin cover panel offset downward. Isometric from below-side so deck, frame, springs, dashpots, mass and cover gap are all readable, cut edges fading to light-grey void.
visual_plan.operating_moment: In-service resonant operation at midspan with deck excited from above and lock released: steel mass free to bounce vertically on springs while dashpots stroke, cover opened for visibility, deck top unchanged and concealed in normal use.
visual_plan.transfer_path: Pedestrian crowd load into deck to girders to bolted bearer frame to helical springs and viscous dashpots to tuned steel mass moving out of phase, deck acceleration reduced to comfortable level.
visual_plan.interactions: Bearer frame bolt-clamped to girders without welding; springs seated on frame and carrying mass from below; dashpots pinned between frame and mass; mass floats with static sag plus vertical stroke clearance to stops; cover hung below frame, shown detached to expose mechanism but aligned for re-fit.
avoid: full landscape, sky, river or street setting
sketch colours, arrows or handwritten notes
text values, units or dimension lines in image
hiding mass, springs or dashpots inside cover

focus_parts.purpose: carries crowd load and vibrates in first vertical mode
clamps to girders to carry damper without welding
moves vertically to absorb bridge resonance
supports mass and sets tuned frequency
dissipates resonant energy as mass moves
conceals unit and opens for inspection and retuning
